# WM. F. Spencer Funeral Service

Family funeral service at 575 E Broadway, South Boston, MA 02127.
Established 1896; at the present address since December 1946.
Phone: 617-268-0855 (any hour, any day). Email: spencer575@gmail.com.

Services: traditional funeral services, cremation services, personalization
(tribute video, keepsakes, live streaming), veterans services, preplanning,
grief support, and an online obituary listing.

Published starting prices: direct cremation from $1,345; traditional service
from $5,170. Full General Price List on the services page.

Site: https://www.spencerfuneralservice.com/
Redesign prototype: https://jared-the-automator.github.io/redesign-portfolio/spencerfuneralservice.com/
